items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Well, practically I knew practically all the old timers around. Steve Lewis. Yeah. Walter Pigeon, Fats Pigeon, and Red Caillou, Udell Wilson.

ctx.x: And you remember the earliest piano players that you heard in New Orleans? Did you hear any of the players in the district, for instance?
Well, practically I knew practically all the old timers around. Steve Lewis. Yeah. Walter Pigeon, Fats Pigeon, and Red Caillou, Udell Wilson.
